title: Postdoctoral Research Fellowship – AI in Power and Energy Systems
description:
Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Coimbatore Campus is inviting applications from qualified candidates for the post of Postdoctoral Research Fellowship – AI in Power and Energy Systems
  
**For Details Contact:** s\_rahul1@cb.amrita.edu
  
  
Job Title
  
Postdoctoral Research Fellowship – AI in Power and Energy Systems
  
  
Required Number
  
1
  
  
Qualification
  
  
Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field
  
  
Demonstrated expertise in machine learning, deep learning, or data science
  
  
Solid foundation in power systems, energy system modeling, or control systems
  
  
Programming experience in MATLAB, Python, and relevant ML libraries
  
  
Job Description
  
  
Amrita School of Artificial Intelligence invites applications for a Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in the interdisciplinary area of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Power & Energy Systems, under the supervision of Dr. Rahul Satheesh.
  
  
This position is part of the school’s thrust area group “AI Innovations in Power, Energy, and Electric Vehicles”, with a strong emphasis on leveraging data-driven technologies to enhance the resilience, efficiency, and intelligence of future energy infrastructures.
  
  
We are particularly looking for candidates who are passionate about integrating machine learning techniques with challenges in power systems, renewable energy, smart grids, and electric mobility.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Conduct independent and collaborative research on:**  
Intelligent energy system control and forecasting
  
  
Data-driven energy system optimization and predictive maintenance
  
  
Grid restoration and resilience under uncertainty
  
  
Detection and mitigation of anomalies or cyber-physical threats
  
  
Develop and validate simulations and prototypes using AI/ML frameworks
  
  
Publish in leading journals and conferences in AI, power systems, and smart energy
  
  
Contribute to grant proposals and assist in mentoring MTech/PhD students
  
  
Engage with industry and academic collaborators for joint research initiatives
  
  
Job Category
  
Research
  
  
Last Date to Apply
  
October 31, 2026

title: Data Science Trainer
description:
Data Science Trainer

Job description:

**Data Science Trainer**

Company: iROHUB Infotech

**Job Description**

iROHUB Infotech is hiring a Data Science Trainer who has strong analytical skills and a passion for teaching. The role involves training students in data science concepts while also working on real\-time data\-driven projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct Data Science training sessions for students
* Teach Python for Data Science, Statistics, and Machine Learning concepts
* Mentor students in academic and real\-time projects
* Guide students in data analysis, model building, and deployment
* Prepare training materials, assignments, and assessments
* Review student performance and provide constructive feedback
* Work on internal or client\-based data science projects
* Coordinate with academic and placement teams

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Python, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn
* Experience with Machine Learning algorithms
* Knowledge of SQL and databases
* Basics of Deep Learning is an added advantage
* Experience with tools like Jupyter Notebook, Google Colab
* Good communication and mentoring skills

* Any Degree/Diploma in Computer Science, Data Science, IT, or related field
